programme.title: Cold Pursuit
programme.desc: When his son’s mysterious death shatters his quiet life, a snowplough driver targets a local drug cartel and embarks on a relentless quest for revenge.

programme.title: Only The Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: How To Get Ahead In Advertising
programme.desc: Denis Dimbleby Bagley (Richard E Grant) is a brilliant young advertising executive who can't come up with a slogan to sell a revolutionary new spot cream. His obsessive worrying affects his relationship with his wife (Rachel Ward), friends and boss, plus his own body - graphically demonstrated when he grows a large stress-related boil on his shoulder. What happens next could make anyone paranoid!

programme.title: The Salamander
programme.desc: After her father's death, 40-year-old Catherine escapes to Brazil, where a fling with a young man turns into a passionate affair - forcing her to confront desire, freedom, and tough choices.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: Film review with David Stratton and Margaret Pomeranz. Features Margaret's Singapore Film Festival report with interviews, plus reviews of Map of the Human Heart, I Give My Everything, Womb for Hire.

programme.title: One Of Our Aircraft Is Missing
programme.desc: During a raid on Germany, a British bomber crew is forced to bail out after their plane is damaged. They land in Holland and are aided by Dutch civilians.

programme.title: The Scarlet And The Black
programme.desc: A Vatican priest hides thousands of escaped prisoners of war and Jews in occupied Rome in WWII after defying the orders of a Nazi colonel. (Gregory Peck, Christopher Plummer, John Gielgud)

programme.title: Good Morning, Vietnam
programme.desc: In 1965, an unorthodox and irreverent DJ named Adrian Cronauer begins to shake up things when he is assigned to the U.S. Armed Services radio station in Vietnam.

programme.title: We Don't Need a Map
programme.desc: Filmmaker Warwick Thornton investigates our relationship to the Southern Cross, in this fun and thought provoking ride through Australia's cultural and political landscape.

programme.title: A Hard Day's Night
programme.desc: Over two "typical" days in the life of The Beatles, the boys struggle to keep themselves and Paul McCartney's mischievous grandfather in check while preparing for a live television performance.

programme.title: The Loss of a Teardrop Diamond
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Mississippi, this film follows the tumultuous romance between a rebellious socialite and the handsome young man she hires as her escort.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: While travelling in continental Europe, a rich young playgirl realizes that an elderly lady seems to have disappeared from the train.

programme.title: Frame By Frame
programme.desc: Charting her rise as a filmmaker from Nulla Nulla to Windcatcher & Thou Shalt Not Steal. Through her short film Finding Jedda, we explore her influences, family lineage and deep connection to Country.

programme.title: Frame By Frame
programme.desc: Using her short film Confessions of a Headhunter as a lens, we highlight Sally's evolution from filmmaker to leader across the Australian screen industry and her impact championing Indigenous voices.

programme.title: The Tower
programme.desc: A Christmas Eve party at a luxury residential building takes a horrific turn when a fire breaks out.

programme.title: The Raid
programme.desc: A SWAT team is trapped in a tenement run by a ruthless mobster and his army of killers and thugs. Stranded on the sixth floor, they must fight their way through the city's worst to survive.

programme.title: Cold Pursuit

programme.title: Boychoir

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes

programme.title: Made in England: The Films of Powell and Pressburger

programme.desc: A Labrador puppy has been raced into the clinic suffering uncontrollable convulsions. The terrified Archie has eaten enough snail bait to kill him. Has Chris got him in time, or will the poison shut down his system?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigations
programme.desc: Approaching the end of its ten-hour journey from Beijing, a British Airways flight is inexplicably crippled by double engine failure. While the plane narrowly misses the buildings and radio towers in its path, it crashes on the tarmac, ripping off the engines and landing gear. Aviation experts and engineers investigate to uncover exactly what caused this near catastrophe.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigations
programme.desc: A Scandinavian Airlines flight is mired in snow and slush at Stockholm airport. Despite the winter conditions, the aircraft takes off smoothly. The plane has lost all power and is falling quickly and silently from the sky, hits the ground and breaks into three pieces.

Narrated by Chris Gabardi.
